rationale: Replace absolute TVL as the primary opportunity gate with range-local capital efficiency.
Combine high volume/active-liquidity, realized fee capture, two-way flow, unwindability and inventory containment.
Preserve one-sided SOL positioning and broad ranges suggested by profitable-wallet research.

position.reason: Broad asymmetric one-sided SOL baseline; profitable-wallet evidence strongly favored >50-bin ranges.

threshold_basis.fee_multiple: Two full modeled round-trip cost hurdles; fixed round-trip cost is 350,000 lamports.
threshold_basis.two_way_balance: Minority directional volume must be at least 25% of directional flow.
threshold_basis.drift: Net displacement may consume at most half of total near-range travel.
threshold_basis.capacity: Paper capital may be at most 10% of pre-entry liquidity in the proposed range.
threshold_basis.unwind: 50% token-inventory stress unwind may cost no more than two modeled round-trip cost hurdles (70 bps).

management.exit: withdraw full range and liquidate residual token inventory to SOL using verified market state

interpretation: This is a new candidate, not a modification of either previously frozen DLMM experiment.
Passing discovery ranking alone is never entry authority.
Failure to produce trades is a valid result; thresholds must not be lowered to manufacture qualification.

amendment_history.reason: Clarify before any prospective outcome that one swap is insufficient to diagnose persistent one-way flow; require at least two swaps in the latest verified segment for the flow-risk early exit.
